reference_sql:
WITH line_sets AS (  -- one row per set of matching order lines
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_lines
  FROM order_lines
  GROUP BY order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_eur, promo_id, line_discount_eur
),
checks AS (  -- one row per check
  SELECT 'resent_copies' AS check_name, SUM(n_lines - 1) AS n_bad FROM line_sets
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'price_in_cents', COUNT(*) FROM order_lines ol JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id WHERE ol.unit_price_eur > 10 * p.unit_cost_eur
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'sku_not_standard', COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE sku <> UPPER(TRIM(sku))
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'missing_category', COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE category_id IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'overlapping_prices', COUNT(DISTINCT a.product_id) FROM price_history a JOIN price_history b ON b.product_id = a.product_id AND b.valid_from > a.valid_from AND (a.valid_to IS NULL OR b.valid_from <= a.valid_to)
)
SELECT check_name, n_bad, CASE WHEN n_bad = 0 THEN 'pass' ELSE 'fail' END AS result
FROM checks

solver.query:
WITH sets AS (SELECT order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_eur, promo_id, line_discount_eur, COUNT(*) AS n FROM order_lines GROUP BY order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_eur, promo_id, line_discount_eur),
chk AS (
  SELECT 'resent_copies' AS check_name, (SELECT SUM(n - 1) FROM sets) AS n_bad
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'price_in_cents', (SELECT count(*) FROM order_lines ol JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id WHERE ol.unit_price_eur > 10 * p.unit_cost_eur)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'sku_not_standard', (SELECT count(*) FROM products WHERE sku <> upper(trim(sku)))
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'missing_category', (SELECT count(*) FROM products WHERE category_id IS NULL)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'overlapping_prices', (SELECT count(DISTINCT a.product_id) FROM price_history a JOIN price_history b ON a.product_id = b.product_id AND a.valid_from < b.valid_from WHERE b.valid_from <= COALESCE(a.valid_to, DATE '9999-12-31'))
)
SELECT check_name, n_bad, CASE WHEN n_bad = 0 THEN 'pass' ELSE 'fail' END AS result FROM chk
